raw_response:
I'm Old Wang — 65 this year, been working these 5 mu since I was young. Let me think through the year.

My land: three mu in cotton, two mu in wheat-maize rotation. Cotton is the cash, wheat and maize feed the family — we grind our own flour, and maize goes to the pigs and some we sell. Been doing it this way a long time. Not going to change now.

**Labor is my worry.** My wife helps but her back isn't good. Two sons work in Handan and Beijing — they send money but only come home for Spring Festival, maybe cotton picking if things are slow in the city. Daughter-in-law has the two grandchildren. So most days it's me and the old woman. At 65, I can still do what needs doing, but I'm slower than I was.

**Cotton (3 mu)** — I'll plant around April 20, when the ground's warm enough. I use regular seed from the county agri-shop, about 35 yuan per mu. The Bt variety is better for bollworm but costs double — on 3 mu I'd rather spray a few more times. Before planting I put compound fertilizer, about 25 kg per mu (the 15-15-15 kind). At squaring I topdress urea, around 15 kg. That should give me the nitrogen the plants need — the extension fellow always says cotton is hungry. I'll spray maybe 4 times: bollworm in July and August, aphids earlier, and if I see wilt I'll treat it. Two irrigations usually — once at squaring if no rain, once at boll fill. Last year I got about 230 kg lint per mu, that's my target again.

**Wheat (2 mu)** — Already in the ground since October. I put diammonium phosphate at planting, about 20 kg per mu. Spring is coming now so I'll topdress urea at jointing, maybe 12 kg per mu. If it stays dry I'll water at jointing and again at grain fill — well water costs electricity so I don't overdo it. Herbicide for weeds early spring, one aphid spray near heading. Usually get 400 kg per mu. Combine comes through the village around June 8, costs 50 yuan per mu to cut and thresh — worth every fen at my age.

**Maize (2 mu)** — Right after wheat harvest, maybe June 12. Tight window. I hire Old Liu's no-till planter, 30 yuan per mu — I can't be plowing in that heat. Hybrid seed, about 50 yuan per mu. Base compound fertilizer 30 kg at planting, then urea 15 kg at big trumpet stage. One spray for corn borer. One irrigation if late July is dry. 450 kg per mu if the weather cooperates.

I keep some cash back. You never know — a grandchild gets sick, the well pump breaks, someone in the village has a wedding. At my age I don't take chances with the money.
